metadata.scope: Source-backed leadership profile pilot prioritising companies with elevated radar pressure.
metadata.limitations: Biographies are abbreviated from official issuer materials. Portraits and official-site icons are cached only where a stable issuer-published asset was available; initials are used otherwise.

ceo.name: Wael Sawan
ceo.summary: Shell executive with more than two decades at the group across upstream, downstream and integrated-gas leadership roles. He became Chief Executive in January 2023.

chair.name: Sir Andrew Mackenzie
chair.summary: Former BHP chief executive and geologist with extensive international energy and resources experience. He has chaired Shell since May 2021.

ceo.name: Stuart Machin
ceo.summary: Retail operator who joined M&S in 2018 and led its food business before becoming Chief Executive in May 2022, with responsibility for the group's transformation and growth strategy.

chair.name: Archie Norman
chair.summary: Experienced listed-company chair and retail leader, formerly chief executive and chair of Asda and chair of ITV. He has chaired M&S since September 2017.

ceo.name: Chris O'Shea
ceo.summary: Chartered accountant and energy executive who served as Centrica CFO before becoming Group Chief Executive in April 2020.

chair.name: Scott Wheway
chair.summary: Experienced utilities and consumer-sector chair who previously held senior roles at Aviva and Tesco. He became Centrica Chair in March 2020.

ceo.name: David Schwimmer
ceo.summary: Former Goldman Sachs executive with a career spanning market structure, capital markets and financial technology. He has led LSEG since August 2018.

chair.name: Don Robert CBE
chair.summary: Former Experian chief executive and experienced financial-services chair. He has chaired LSEG since May 2019.

ceo.name: Fernando Fernandez
ceo.summary: Long-serving Unilever executive whose leadership roles included Latin America and the group's Beauty & Wellbeing business before his appointment as CEO in March 2025.

chair.name: Ian Meakins
chair.summary: Former Wolseley chief executive and experienced international company chair. He became Chair of Unilever in December 2023.

ceo.name: Elie Maalouf
ceo.summary: Hospitality executive who led IHG's Americas business before becoming Group Chief Executive in July 2023.

chair.name: Deanna Oppenheimer
chair.summary: International consumer and financial-services leader with extensive board experience. She became IHG Chair in September 2022.

ceo.name: Simon Trott
ceo.summary: Rio Tinto executive with operating and commercial leadership experience across iron ore and group strategy. He became Chief Executive in August 2025.

chair.name: Dominic Barton
chair.summary: Former global managing partner of McKinsey and Canada's ambassador to China, with extensive international policy and business experience. He has chaired Rio Tinto since May 2022.

ceo.name: Georges Elhedery
ceo.summary: International banker who held senior markets, regional and finance roles at HSBC before becoming Group Chief Executive in September 2024.

chair.name: Brendan Nelson
chair.summary: Former KPMG vice-chair and experienced bank director who served as HSBC's interim Chair before being appointed permanently in 2025.

ceo.name: Murray Auchincloss
ceo.summary: BP executive with deep finance and strategy experience who served as CFO and interim CEO before being appointed Chief Executive in January 2024.

chair.name: Albert Manifold
chair.summary: Former CRH chief executive with extensive global industrial, capital-allocation and M&A experience. He became BP Chair in October 2025.

ceo.name: Nathan Coe
ceo.summary: Auto Trader executive who previously served as CFO and COO before becoming Chief Executive in March 2020.

chair.name: Matt Davies
chair.summary: Experienced UK retail and listed-company leader, formerly chief executive of Pets at Home and Halfords. He became Auto Trader Chair in September 2023.

ceo.name: Damian Gammell
ceo.summary: International beverages executive with more than 30 years in the Coca-Cola system. He has led CCEP since December 2016 and oversaw its expansion into Australia, the Pacific and the Philippines.

chair.name: Sol Daurella
chair.summary: Experienced international company director with extensive Coca-Cola bottling and consumer-sector experience. She has chaired CCEP since May 2016.

ceo.name: Mike Norris
ceo.summary: Long-serving Computacenter executive who joined the group in 1984 and has served as Chief Executive since 1994, leading its development into an international technology-services business.

chair.name: Peter Ryan
chair.summary: Technology-sector leader with international experience across software, services, systems integration and infrastructure, including senior roles at Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Logica and Sun Microsystems.

ceo.name: Duncan Wanblad
ceo.summary: Mining engineer with more than 30 years of global industry experience and a long Anglo American career spanning copper, base metals, strategy and business development. He became Chief Executive in April 2022.

chair.name: Stuart Chambers
chair.summary: Former Pilkington and Nippon Sheet Glass chief executive with extensive industrial and listed-company board experience, including chairing ARM and Rexam. He has chaired Anglo American since November 2017.

ceo.name: Simon Borrows
ceo.summary: Former investment banker who joined 3i as Chief Investment Officer in 2011 and became Chief Executive in May 2012. His earlier roles included leadership positions at Greenhill and Baring Brothers.

chair.name: David Hutchison OBE
chair.summary: Former investment banker and social-finance executive who joined the 3i board in 2013 and became Chair in November 2021.

ceo.name: Iván Arriagada
ceo.summary: Commercial engineer and economist with more than 30 years in mining and energy, including senior roles at Codelco, BHP Billiton and Shell. He joined Antofagasta in 2015 and became Group CEO in 2016.

chair.name: Jean-Paul Luksic
chair.summary: Antofagasta leader with more than 30 years at the group, including oversight of major mine developments and service as mining-division CEO. He has chaired the company since 2004.
